# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_RIBBON_ALIGN_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price opens above the opening‑range high and stays above VWAP with a bullish EMA ribbon for several bars, the intraday bias is upward. This edge exists because it captures the continuation of strong morning momentum that often persists into the early session, especially when supported by volume and trend alignment.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: At the close of any 5‑min bar after 09:45 ET, enter long if: (1) price > OR_high (high of first 15‑min bar), (2) price > VWAP, (3) EMA9 > EMA20 > EMA50, and (4) the last three consecutive bars satisfy conditions 1‑3. Exit shape: Chart‑stop at the most recent swing low (prior HH/HL invalidation) or a 0.5% trailing stop; take profit at 1.5R or when the ribbon turns bearish (EMA9 < EMA20). Regime hint: Best when VIX < 18 and during the first two hours of the session; avoid choppy periods where OR width < 0.2% of price.
